responsibility: Implements an early AST-level validation pass for Rust source constructs before later HIR-based semantic checks. By extending the contextual AST visitor, it enforces syntax/semantic restrictions such as disallowing keyword-based lifetime and loop-label names, rejecting empty unions and unsafe modules, checking free/associated/external function body and qualifier rules including self parameters and C-variadics, validating impl-associated constants with missing bodies, and enforcing auto-trait restrictions, emitting direct frontend diagnostics for malformed AST forms.
same_name_distinction: Implements the ASTValidation pass in the parent errors directory, with the concrete visitor checks and diagnostics for modules, functions, unions, traits, lifetimes, loop labels, and constants; unlike the header, it contains the actual validation rules and emitted errors.
